biotools.summary: ALDEx3 implements scale-reliant mixed-effects models (SR-MEM) for robust and principled differential abundance analysis of microbiome sequence count data. It addresses limitations of standard mixed-effects models by explicitly modeling unmeasured biological scale uncertainty, improving reproducibility in complex experimental designs.
